spec.name: IBGW-poller restarts
spec.query: SELECT "d" FROM (     SELECT difference("epoch_ns") AS d     FROM "ib_derived_pnl"     WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'prod'   ) WHERE "d" > 0

SELECT last("qty") AS "qty", last("avg_cost") AS "avg_cost", last("multiplier") AS "multiplier"
  FROM "ib_position"
  WHERE ("account" =~ /^$account$/) AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/
    AND time >= ${__to}ms - 30s AND time <= ${__to}ms
  GROUP BY "account", "symbol"

SELECT last("market_price") AS "mark_px", last("market_value") AS "market_value",
         last("unrealized_pnl") AS "upnl", last("daily_pnl") AS "daily_pnl"
  FROM "ib_position_pnl"
  WHERE ("account" =~ /^$account$/) AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/
    AND time >= ${__to}ms - 30s AND time <= ${__to}ms
  GROUP BY "account", "symbol"

SELECT "symbol", "side", "event", "qty", "filled",
         "limit_price", "fill_qty", "fill_price", "perm_id"
  FROM "hedger_order_event"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "event" != 'ValidationError' AND "event" != 'PendingCancel'
  ORDER BY time DESC

spec.title: Hedger order events
spec.description: Recommended to filter entire dashboard to a single symbol to view

spec.query: SELECT "qty" * "limit_price" FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "event"='PendingSubmit' GROUP BY "symbol", "event", "side"
SELECT "fill_qty" * "fill_price" FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "event"='Fill' GROUP BY "symbol", "event", "side"

SELECT ("qty" - "filled") * "limit_price" FROM "hedger_order_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "event"='Cancelled' GROUP BY "symbol", "event", "side"

SELECT min("connected") FROM "ib_poller_heartbeat"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "env" fill(-1)

SELECT min("poller_up") FROM "ib_poller_heartbeat"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "env" fill(0)

SELECT min("up") FROM "rwa_poller_heartbeat"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "env" fill(0)

SELECT last("enriched_state") FROM "hedger_heartbeat"
WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "env" fill(null)

spec.title: Perp vs hedge slippage (directional, vol-weighted)
spec.description: Direction-adjusted volume-weighted perp-vs-hedge slippage, 2m buckets. 2m width chosen so a perp print and its trailing ~1min TWAP hedge fall in the SAME window (both legs share one time(2m) grid so the join holds). Per bucket: VWAP = sum(notional)/sum(last_qty) per leg. Direction = sign of sum(signed_qty) on perp leg (>0 Buy, <0 Sell). Slippage sign-adjusted so POSITIVE = ADVERSE (bought above / sold below perp ref): adj_slip = (hedge_vwap - perp_vwap) * sign(perp signed_qty). Slip notional ($) = adj_slip * Volume; sort to find costly buckets. Volume (qty) = hedge last_qty; filter Volume >= N to drop noise. Vol-weighted avg adverse slippage = footer SUM(Slip notional)/SUM(Volume). CAVEATS: a perp trade near a 2m boundary whose hedge completes after the boundary straddles two buckets (minority case, irreducible without event-grouping). Back-to-back perp trades <2m apart merge into one bucket (visible as high Volume). Direction is NET per bucket. Missing-leg buckets show —. This is the InfluxQL ceiling; true per-trade markout needs Flux or upstream precompute.

spec.query: SELECT sum("notional") AS "hedge_notional" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE ("leg_type"::tag = 'hedge') AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)
SELECT sum("last_qty") AS "hedge_qty" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE ("leg_type"::tag = 'hedge') AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)
SELECT sum("notional") AS "perp_notional" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE ("leg_type"::tag = 'perp') AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)
SELECT sum("last_qty") AS "perp_qty" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE ("leg_type"::tag = 'perp') AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)
SELECT sum("signed_qty") AS "perp_signed_qty" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE ("leg_type"::tag = 'perp') AND "account" =~ /^$account$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)
SELECT last("connected")  FROM "ib_poller_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "env"
SELECT last("poller_up")  FROM "ib_poller_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "env"
SELECT last("up")         FROM "rwa_poller_heartbeat" WHERE time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "env"
SELECT last("healthy")    FROM "hedger_heartbeat"     WHERE time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "env"

SELECT difference(last("pnl")) FROM "ib_derived_pnl"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "env", "account", "currency" fill(none)

SELECT difference(last("epoch_ns")) FROM "ib_derived_pnl"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "env", "account", "currency" fill(none)

SELECT sum("notional") FROM "ib_fill"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(0)

SELECT "symbol", "side", "qty", "multiplier", "price", "notional", "account", "perm_id"
  FROM "ib_fill"
  WHERE ("account" =~ /^$account$/) AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND $timeFilter
  ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT sum("notional") FROM "ib_fill"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(0)

SELECT last("market_value") AS "market_value"
  FROM "ib_position_pnl"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol"

spec.description: Enable query B to display trades. If many symbols are enabled, will likely timeout.

spec.query:

  WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/
  GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT "price" FROM "ib_trade"

  GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT "price" FROM "ib_fill"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "symbol" =~ /^$symbol$/ AND "account" =~ /^$account$/
